items.title: 3.3.2 Valence shell electron pair repulsion model (VSEPR) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 3.3.2, printed pages 52-58.

blocks.text: VSEPR model molecules ki shaklein darmiyani atom ke gird electron pairs se bayan karta hai. Ise Sidgwick aur Powell ne 1940 mein pesh kiya aur yeh is mafrooze par qaim hai ke molecule woh shakal leta hai jis mein darmiyani atom ke valence electrons ke darmiyan barqi dhakel (electronic repulsions) kam se kam ho. Kam se kam dhakel ke liye electron pairs apne aap ko zyada se zyada mumkin faslon par tarteeb dete hain, aur yehi tarteeb molecule ki geometry tai karti hai.

items: Lone pairs (ghair-bandhe) aur bond pairs dono molecules ki geometries tai karne mein hissa lete hain.
Electron pairs darmiyani atom ke gird is tarah tarteeb pate hain ke zyada se zyada fasle par rahein aur dhakel se bachein.

Lone pairs ke electrons bond pairs se zyada jagah lete hain, to ghair-bandhe pairs bandhe hue pairs par zyada dhakelne wali quwwat lagate hain aur unhen dabate hain. Dhakel is tarteeb mein ghatti hai: lone pair-lone pair > lone pair-bond pair > bond pair-bond pair. Do nuclei ka baanta hua electron pair ek nucleus se bandhe lone pair se kam jagah leta hai.
Double bond ke do electron pairs aur triple bond ke teen zyada charge density rakhte hain, magar unhen ek pair gina jata hai.
Darmiyani atom ke saath bohat electronegative atoms bond pairs ke darmiyan dhakel kam karte hain, magar lone pair ki dhakel mazboot.

blocks.text: Darmiyani atom ka naam A aur us ke gird electron pairs B rakhe jate hain, jo A ki valency ke mutabiq AB2, AB3, AB4 waghaira qism ke molecules dete hain. Electron pair geometry A ke gird kul electron pairs ki tadaad se tai hoti hai, jabke molecule ki asal shakal atoms se, lone pairs ko chhor kar. Qadam yeh hain: darmiyani atom chunein, aam taur par sab se kam electronegative atom ya sab se kam atoms wala unsur (CCl4 mein carbon); us ke gird electron pairs ginein, bond pairs aur lone pairs (CCl4 mein chaar bond pairs aur koi lone pair nahi); table se electron pair geometry parhein (chaar pairs, tetrahedral); phir lone pairs chhor kar shakal batayein.

blocks.caption: Covalent bandhe hue compounds ki geometries aur shaklein (Table 3.1)

blocks.text: AB2 molecules mein do electron pairs 180 degrees par hote hain, linear geometry: BeCl2 mein beryllium darmiyani atom hai jis ke do bond pairs aur koi lone pair nahi. AB3 molecules mein teen electron pairs 120 degrees par, trigonal geometry: BF3 trigonal planar hai jis ka har F-B-F zawiya 120 degrees hai, aur group 13 ke hydrides, AlH3, GaH3 aur BH3, se bhi yehi mutawaqqa hai. SnCl2 mein tin atom ke chaar bairooni electrons hain; woh do bonds banata hai aur baqi do lone pair ke taur par rakhta hai jo tikon ka ek kona leta hai, jo bukharat (vapour) mein bigri hui trigonal electron pair geometry aur 120 degrees se kam zawiye wala v-shaped molecule deta hai. Multiple bonds ke saath, SO3 ke teenon ilaqe S=O bonds se bhare hain aur woh 120 degrees par bilkul trigonal hai, jabke SO2 mein ek kone par lone pair aur baqi do par double bond hai, to woh SnCl2 ki tarah mura hua hai.

AB4 molecules mein chaar electron pairs ek doosre se bachne ke liye ba-qaida tetrahedron ke kone lete hain, 109.5 degrees ke bond zawiyon ke saath. Methane mein carbon ke chaar valence electrons mein se har ek hydrogen atom ke akele electron se jora banata hai, aur chaar bond pairs tetrahedron ke konon ki taraf hain, ghair-musattah (non-planar) tarteeb; har H-C-H zawiya 109.5 degrees hai, aur SiH4, GeH4 aur CCl4 ki shakal wahi hai. Tetrahedron ke chaar kone, chaar chehre, chhe kinare aur chhe bond zawiye hote hain. Ammonia mein nitrogen ke gird teen atoms aur ek lone pair hain; lone pair misali 109.5 degrees ko 107 degrees kar deta hai aur molecule trigonal pyramid hai. Hydrogen ki jagah electronegative atoms zawiya aur kam karte hain: NF3 mein zawiye 102.5 degrees tak dabte hain, kyunke N-F bond ki shadeed polarity nitrogen ko lone pair qareeb khinchne deti hai, jo bonding electrons ko zyada dhakelta hai, aur kyunke bond pairs fluorine atoms ke qareeb hain, jo un ki aapas ki dhakel kamzor karta hai. Pani chaar electron pairs ke saath v-shaped hai, jin mein do lone pairs tetrahedron ke do konon par hain; un ki zyada dhakel zawiya 104.5 degrees kar deti hai. Ions bhi inhi qaidon par chalte hain: hydronium ion H3O+, jo pani ke proton pakarne se banta hai, ek lone pair wala AB4 hai aur ammonia ki tarah trigonal pyramidal; amide ion NH2- ke do lone pairs aur do bond pairs hain, tetrahedral geometry aur pani jaisi muri hui (v) shakal.

AB5 molecules mein paanch electron pairs trigonal bipyramid ke konon par phailte hain: teen jagahein musattah tikon mein aur do plane ke amood mehwar par, jaise PCl5 mein, plane ke andar 120 degrees aur mehwari (axial) aur musattah atom ke darmiyan 90 degrees ke zawiyon ke saath. Yahan lone pairs shakal zyada dramaai taur par badalte hain. Tri-iodide ion I3- linear hai halanke woh AB5 system hai: darmiyani iodine ke paanch pairs hain, do bond pairs aur teen lone pairs, to us ki geometry trigonal bipyramidal hai; lone pairs tikon ke teen kone lete hain aur do iodine atoms plane ke oopar aur neeche ki chotiyan, aur lone pairs chhor kar shakal linear hai jis mein iodine atoms 180 degrees par hain. AB6 molecules mein chhe electron pairs octahedral geometry lete hain, chaar musattah murabbe ke konon par aur do amood mehwar par, sab zawiye 90 degrees, jaise SF6 mein. XeF4 chaar bond pairs aur do lone pairs wala AB6 hai; lone pairs 180 degrees par sab se door rehte hain, aur unhen chhor kar shakal square planar hai jis ke sab zawiye 90 degrees hain.

blocks.alt: Molecules ke das chapte khaake: linear BeCl2, trigonal BF3, jamni lone pair ke saath mura SnCl2, tetrahedral CH4, ek lone pair wala pyramidal NH3, do ke saath mura H2O, trigonal bipyramidal PCl5, plane mein teen lone pairs ke saath linear I3-, octahedral SF6 aur do mukhalif lone pairs ke saath square planar XeF4; ek dabba dhakel ki tarteeb deta hai.
blocks.caption: VSEPR geometries aur shaklein un ke zawiyon ke saath (Table 3.1 aur Figures 3.9 se 3.20 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Do pairs 180 degrees par seedhi lakeer dete hain, teen 120 degrees par chapta tikon, chaar 109.5 degrees par tetrahedron, paanch 120 aur 90 degrees par trigonal bipyramid, aur chhe 90 degrees par octahedron. Lone pairs geometry ke liye gine jate hain magar shakal ke liye nahi, aur kyunke woh bond pairs se zyada phailte hain woh bonds ko dabate hain: NH3 107 degrees tak, H2O 104.5 degrees tak, SnCl2 aur SO2 120 degrees se neeche. Trigonal bipyramid ke plane mein teen lone pairs I3- ko linear chhorte hain; octahedron par do mukhalif lone pairs XeF4 ko square planar.

blocks.prompt: SiH4, H2Se aur PH3 mein bond pairs aur lone pairs ginein, un ki shaklon aur zawiyon ka andaza lagayein, aur batayein ke H2S ka zawiya H2O se kaise mukhtalif hai.
blocks.explanation: SiH4: chaar bond pairs, koi lone pair nahi, tetrahedral, 109.5 degrees. PH3: teen bond pairs aur ek lone pair, trigonal pyramidal, 109.5 degrees se thora kam. H2Se: do bond pairs aur do lone pairs, v-shaped, 109.5 degrees se kaafi kam. H2S, H2Se ki tarah, v-shaped hai, magar us ka zawiya pani ke 104.5 degrees se chhota hai (taqreeban 92 degrees) kyunke sulfur ke bare orbitals aur mazboot lone pair dhakel bonds ko qareeb dhakelte hain.

items: VSEPR (Sidgwick aur Powell, 1940): darmiyani atom ke gird electron pairs zyada se zyada door rehte hain; lone pairs geometry ke liye ginte hain, shakal ke liye nahi, aur sab se zyada dhakelte hain (lp-lp > lp-bp > bp-bp); multiple bonds ek pair ginte hain.

AB2 linear 180; AB3 trigonal 120 (ek lone pair: v-shaped, SnCl2, SO2); AB4 tetrahedral 109.5 (NH3 107, NF3 102.5, H2O 104.5; H3O+ pyramidal, NH2- mura); AB5 trigonal bipyramidal 120 aur 90 (I3- teen lone pairs ke saath linear); AB6 octahedral 90 (XeF4 do lone pairs ke saath square planar).
